properties.name: Central Riyadh
properties.description: The historical and administrative heart of Riyadh, home to Al-Murabba Palace and key government institutions.

properties.name: Olaya
properties.description: Riyadh's premier business and commercial corridor, lined with towers, hotels, and retail destinations.

properties.name: Al Malaz
properties.description: A vibrant mixed-use residential and commercial district in the eastern inner city.

properties.name: King Abdullah Financial District
properties.description: KAFD is Riyadh's modern financial hub — a master-planned mixed-use district on the northern edge of the city.

properties.name: Diplomatic Quarter
properties.description: A leafy enclave in western Riyadh housing embassies, residences, and parks — one of the most walkable areas in the city.

properties.name: King Fahd District
properties.description: Named after King Fahd Road — a major business and retail artery connecting northern and central Riyadh.

properties.name: Al Nuzha
properties.description: A well-established residential district in northern Riyadh, known for parks and family amenities.

properties.name: Al Andalus
properties.description: A growing residential and mixed-use area in northern Riyadh with increasing transit connectivity.

properties.name: Al Aqiq
properties.description: An upscale western district featuring luxury villas, compounds, and proximity to the Diplomatic Quarter.

properties.name: Al Rawabi
properties.description: A southern Riyadh residential district with growing bus connectivity and urban expansion.
